# LowRankEvolutionStrategies

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A gradient-free training method for spiking neural networks that optimizes parameters by evolving low-rank perturbations instead of computing gradients. Enables training of SNNs on neuromorphic hardware where gradient computation is costly or impossible, expanding deployable learning capabilities.
